correctness.rationale: The cyclic de Bruijn condition is bijective to full-period shift-register feedback tables on 16 four-bit tails; every cycle has one 00000 root. Every balanced circular-substring sum is a difference of prefix sums, so discrepancy equals prefix range. The other Eulerian representation also exhausts exactly all 2048 cycles. In a fresh independent 65536-table enumeration, 2048 yielded complete orbits and discrepancies 5:224, 6:688, 7:912, 8:224, matching the stated histogram and mean 839/128. The claim is exactly finite order five only.
